description: Fixed 128-token windows without syntax or AST boundary awareness.
feedback: Baseline: High boundary fragmentation cutting function signatures in half (1,200+ tokens/task).

description: Atomic top-level function/class closures preserving signature-body integrity.
feedback: Function closure preserves signature-body integrity (+0.052 NDCG), but oversized functions (>500 tokens) cause prompt bloat.

description: Recursively partitions oversized function ASTs at statement/block boundaries with local headers.
feedback: Subtree budgeting splits large functions at statement boundaries, saving 35% tokens while maintaining accuracy.

description: Injects enclosing trait/class/struct definition context into each child method chunk.
feedback: Hierarchical header injection recovers parent struct/trait context, improving multi-method class lookups (+0.024 NDCG).

description: Binds documentation comments explicitly to their decorated AST declaration nodes.
feedback: Docstring-to-AST node binding prevents comment separation, boosting natural language query intent matching.

description: Dual-rate indexing isolating exact type signatures from implementation bodies.
feedback: Signature-body decoupling creates dedicated high-priority symbol matching, reducing prompt tokens to ~310.

description: Augments AST chunks with 1-hop caller/callee function symbol references.
feedback: Call-graph dependency tags resolve cross-function data flow queries, lifting architectural query recall to 98%.

description: Partitions functions along CFG control branching points (match/switch, if-else, try-catch).
feedback: CFG basic-block partitioning isolates error and match branching paths, cutting snippet delivery to ~240 tokens.

description: Dual-rate hierarchy: coarse function vector for Stage 1 filter + fine-grained statement chunks for Stage 2.
feedback: Multi-granularity dual-rate indexing provides coarse function vectors for Stage 1 filter and fine statement chunks for Stage 2.

description: Optimal multi-tier synthesis: Header Injection + Budgeted Subtrees + 1-Hop Symbol Graph + Dual-Rate 1.35b/d MaxSim.
feedback: Optimal unified synthesis: Header Injection + Budgeted Subtrees + 1-Hop Symbol Graph + Dual-Rate 1.35b/d MaxSim scoring.
